sentences.text: The Feeder Protection Relay is known as Tandem in this concept.
The Protection Relay Engineer is known as Larkspur in this concept.
The Feeder Protection Relay provides local protection for its assigned feeder and operates independently of supervisory control availability.
Its approved setting group defines the pickup levels, time delays, and logic required for the feeder protection scheme.
The Protection Relay Engineer develops setting changes against the approved protection study and the current equipment data.
The Protection Relay Engineer documents the engineering basis and expected operational effect for each proposed change.
Engineering Workstation maintains the working configuration under revision control.
Engineering Workstation produces the Settings Review Receipt after a settings review is completed.
Each proposed change receives a unique revision identifier before review begins.
The Protection Relay Engineer verifies that proposed values agree with the approved coordination objectives.
A second qualified reviewer independently checks calculations, logic changes, and device applicability.
The review confirms that the proposed configuration is complete, internally consistent, and suitable for the intended feeder.
Coordination checks consider upstream and downstream protection behavior across the expected operating range.
Protection settings are not approved solely on the basis of copied values from another installation.
Engineering Workstation retains the approved configuration and its revision history for controlled access.
Configuration access is limited to personnel with assigned engineering responsibilities.
The Protection Relay Engineer records the approval status before any setting change is released for implementation.
Before deployment, the approved configuration is checked against the intended device model and firmware version.
A controlled outage or other approved work window is required when implementation could affect feeder protection.
The Substation Field Crew follows the authorized work instructions during device access and setting transfer.
After installation, the implemented values are compared with the approved configuration.
The Feeder Protection Relay is functionally checked to confirm the intended protection behavior after a change.
Any discrepancy stops release of the configuration until its cause is resolved and reviewed.
The Substation Supervisor ensures that engineering changes follow the established authorization and operational control process.
